asset_id.description: Id the asset created/updated in this API call.

asset_uri.description: Asset URI of the asset created/updated.

content_md5.description: Cloud provider checksum. Returned only if creation/updation is completed and successful.

etag.description: ETag of the created/updated asset. Returned only if creation/updation is completed and successful.

monitor_link.description: Monitor link object for getting the upload status. Returned only when asset upload/update is still in progress and http status is 202.

uri.description: Monitor link for getting the upload status.

rename_info.description: If on_dup_name was auto_rename and the name was illegal or a duplicate was encountered, contains details on the rename.

asset_uri.description: If present, the uri of the asset the original_name collided with.

folder_uri.description: If present, the uri of the folder the original_name collided with.

size.description: Size of the uploaded file.(Reported by cloud provider)
